title: Pushouts supported on extreme Hom objects of directed algebroids
statement:
Use the universes and coherent algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and the fixed-object free-algebra functor $G_S:\mathcal V^{S\times S}\to\operatorname{Alg}_{\Delta_S^{\mathrm{op}}}(\mathcal V)$ of [lem-coef-categorical-algebra-free-monad]. Colimits and their mapping-space universal properties have the meaning of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal V$ be presentably monoidal and let $S=S_0\amalg S_1\amalg S_2$ be a small set partitioned into three levels. Write $0_{\mathcal V}$ for the initial object. Let $A$ be a coherent $\mathcal V$-algebroid with object set $S$, such that its unit $\mathbf1\to A(s,s)$ is an equivalence, and $A(s,t)\simeq0_{\mathcal V}$ for distinct $s,t$ unless $s\in S_i,t\in S_j$ with $i<j$. Let $Q,R\in\mathcal V^{S\times S}$ be graphs with $Q(s,t)\simeq R(s,t)\simeq0_{\mathcal V}$ off $S_0\times S_2$, let $h:Q\to R$ be a graph map, and let $u:Q\to V_SA$ be a graph map, where $V_S$ forgets composition. Form the homotopy pushout
$$B=A\amalg_{G_SQ}G_SR$$
in the infinity category of algebroids with object set $S$ and maps fixing $S$, using the adjunct of $u$ and $G_Sh$. Then $B$ has a canonical directed model on $S$ in which the maps $A(s,t)\to B(s,t)$ are equivalences off $S_0\times S_2$, and, for $s\in S_0,t\in S_2$, the canonical square
$$\begin{matrix}Q(s,t)&\longrightarrow&A(s,t)\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ R(s,t)&\longrightarrow&B(s,t)\end{matrix}$$
is a homotopy pushout in $\mathcal V$. Its compositions with nonidentity inputs are the composites
$$A(s,m)\otimes A(m,t)\longrightarrow A(s,t)\longrightarrow B(s,t)\qquad(s\in S_0,m\in S_1,t\in S_2);$$
units are inherited. These identifications are coherent and natural for maps of the diagrams $(A\leftarrow G_SQ\to G_SR)$ preserving the level sets.

source.place: Agent-formulated extreme-Hom pushout lemma using the categorical free-path formula of Proposition A.4.9 and the algebra-colimit machinery of Corollaries A.5.4 and A.5.7. These results do not state this directed pushout calculation verbatim. Read online; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical algebra-colimit fact.
